items.source_en:
Engineer Q. O'Bannon - GENSEC Level 04
Maintenance Request GDM-030-444C

Issue: CGrid Panel Replacement
Location: Conduction Grid
Current Status: Fixed

Notes:
This is the fourteenth CGrid panel to fail this year. Probably shouldn't be surprised, seeing as the tech is over seven decades old. Biggest problem is that we need to climb the entire array to replace the panels, and I don't enjoy dangling from a safety harness that high over the city. Would be nice if the brains in charge of this place would modernize the system.
